hash_semantics: sha256 is the SHA-256 of the repository file bytes at baseline_source_sha, except where the entry explicitly names a distributed artifact. For tracked records, source_commit_sha is the latest commit modifying that record; for external immutable artifacts it identifies the authorized package source. It is never inferred to be the execution source SHA.
